title: Is cryptocurrency the future of finance?
description: The debate evaluates whether cryptocurrencies and related blockchain systems will become a central part of the future financial system.

facts.fact: India ranked first among 151 countries in Chainalysis's 2024 Global Crypto Adoption Index.
India led global crypto adoption for a second consecutive year despite stringent regulation and high trading taxes.
On 10 January 2024 the US SEC approved the listing and trading of spot bitcoin exchange-traded products, bringing bitcoin into mainstream investment funds.
Bitcoin started 2022 at $43,319 and ended the year at $16,604, a 64.2% drop in a single year.
Section 115BBH of India's Income-tax Act taxes income from transferring virtual digital assets at 30%, and such losses cannot be set off or carried forward.
In October 2024 RBI Governor Shaktikanta Das said cryptocurrencies carry huge financial stability, monetary stability and banking-system risks.
